test_title: PYST 59: RRB Group D - GA (Held On: 23 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In November 2025, the Supreme Court of India held that every arrested individual must be provided with the written grounds of arrest in which language?

options.text: A language understood by the arrested person
The language of the arresting officer’s choice
Any official language of the state

solution:
The correct answer is __**A language understood by the arrested person**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Supreme Court of India**, in its ruling in **November 2025**, emphasized that the **grounds of arrest** must be communicated to an individual in a **language they understand** to ensure the protection of their **fundamental rights**.
 
• This mandate is rooted in **Article 22(1)** of the **Constitution of India**, which stipulates that every person who is arrested shall not be detained in custody without being informed, as soon as may be, of the **grounds for such arrest**.
 
• The court clarified that merely providing the **written grounds of arrest** in a language alien to the accused (such as **English** or **Hindi** if the person only knows a regional language) does not fulfill the **constitutional requirement** of "informed" communication.
